name: Chjornyj podsolnuh
source:
He and she are complete opposites.
They live in the same city, go to the same school, but are in completely different worlds.
One hot summer day, they draw pictures ... Two completely opposite pictures immediately decide to send them to an art competition.
So, finally, the two worlds intersect with each other.
But will completely different people be able to understand and accept each other?

[Translated from [url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/5-2-0-313]official site[/url]]
